Hi Sara / Jordan —

Thanks for the clear confirmation, Sara. This note formalizes Redwood's commitment for AcmeFin:

1) Training opt-out: Redwood confirms that we will NOT use any AcmeFin customer-provided data for the purpose of training or improving Redwood models, now or in the future, unless we receive explicit, documented opt-in from AcmeFin. This includes supervised/unsupervised training, fine-tuning, and inclusion in any aggregated datasets used for model updates.

2) PII and redaction: Redwood treats the following as PII for this engagement by default: personal names, email addresses, phone numbers, national identifiers (SSNs), credit card numbers, and account numbers. We provide two options:
   - Auto-mask on ingest: Redwood can apply redaction rules at request-time (recommended) so that PII is replaced before any data is persisted.
   - Post-ingest redaction: Redwood can persist then run scheduled redaction jobs before export.

3) Data retention: We will configure AcmeFin's workspace to retain raw request/response logs for 90 days and derived transcripts for 30 days unless you request a different policy via your account admin. Exports of logs are retained per the same window.

4) Logging & audit: We will provide audit log exports (JSON) including timestamps, route IDs, request metadata, and redaction flags. Full request/response bodies will only be included if explicitly requested and will respect the retention policy above. Exports can be scheduled daily or on-demand.

5) Data residency & encryption: All live traffic and stored data for AcmeFin will be pinned to us-east-1. Data at rest is encrypted using customer-managed keys (optional KMS) and in-transit TLS 1.2+.

6) Signed confirmation & DPA: Attached are the signed opt-out confirmation and a short DPA summary outlining obligations and SLAs (Redwood_Training_OptOut_AcmeFin_signed.pdf, DPA_Summary.pdf). Please let us know if procurement wants any redlines; we'll coordinate with legal.

If that matches your expectations, please reply to confirm and procurement can proceed with the formal sign-off.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
